$comment: status: PROPOSED. Needs sign-off from the engine and web owners before anyone depends on it.
title: EngineApiTypes
description: PROPOSED (not yet signed off by the engine and web owners). Value types that cross the engine API: site_metrics(mask, ephem, t_start, hours, params) -> Metrics, grid_scores(grid, ephem, t_start, hours, weights) -> Float32Array, top_areas(scores, window_cells, n) -> Area[]. This wrapper object exists only so the types can be validated and generated together.

params.title: Params
params.description: PROPOSED. Mission thresholds and the simulation step passed to site_metrics.

battery_h.description: Hours the lander can run without sunlight.

survival_temp_k.description: Surface temperature in kelvin below which an hour counts towards h_below_survival.

antenna_margin_deg.description: Degrees the Earth's centre must be above the terrain mask to count as in contact.

slope_limit_deg.description: Hard slope limit in degrees from horizontal (default 10).

step_hours.description: Fixed simulation time step in hours.

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: PROPOSED. Weights of the greedy evaluator's normalised factors (unitless, each >= 0); score = sum of weight * factor.

rock.description: Weight of low rock abundance (unitless); defaults to 0 because the rock layer is a terrain-roughness proxy, not measured rocks.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: PROPOSED. Result of site_metrics over the window [t_start, t_start + hours].

pct_lit.description: Percent of the window with any of the Sun's disk above the mask, in [0, 100].

longest_dark_h.description: Longest continuous stretch without sunlight, in hours.

pct_earth_visible.description: Percent of the window with the Earth's centre above the mask plus the antenna margin, in [0, 100].

longest_blackout_h.description: Longest continuous stretch without Earth contact, in hours.

h_to_first_sunset.description: Hours from t_start to the first sunset in the window; null when there is none.

h_to_first_earthset.description: Hours from t_start to the first Earthset in the window; null when there is none.

mean_sun_el_deg.description: Mean elevation of the Sun's centre over the window, in degrees above the local horizontal plane.

max_sun_el_deg.description: Highest elevation of the Sun's centre in the window, in degrees above the local horizontal plane.

mean_power_vertical.description: Mean of lit * cos(elevation) for a vertical Sun-tracking panel: a fraction of full normal-incidence power, in [0, 1].

mean_power_horizontal.description: Mean of lit * sin(elevation) for a horizontal panel: a fraction of full normal-incidence power, in [0, 1].

t_min_k.description: Lowest surface temperature in the window, in kelvin (simplified, no thermal inertia).

t_max_k.description: Highest surface temperature in the window, in kelvin (simplified, no thermal inertia).

h_below_survival.description: Hours in the window with surface temperature below survival_temp_k.

area.title: Area
area.description: PROPOSED. One landing area returned by top_areas.

x_m.description: Projected x of the area centre in metres (south polar stereographic, see the grid contract).

y_m.description: Projected y of the area centre in metres (south polar stereographic, see the grid contract).

score.description: Mean weighted score over the area's window (unitless).

radius_m.description: Radius in metres of the area, i.e. of the surroundings excluded from later picks.
